title: Card-swipe memo + contacts (SF DevWeek)
content:
Quick reference memo for card swipes, petty incidentals, and vendor contacts during SF DevWeek. Purpose: single-screen checklist when I'm running errands or handing off receipts to finance. -- TOPLINE NOTES --
- Booth: H27 (Moscone South) — early load-in 07:30 Wed.
- Main organizer: Evan (see collaborators).
- Per diem guidance: $80/day for local staff (on record but still capture receipts for anything > $25).

CARD INFO (virtual / Amex):
- Virtual card (events-vendor) last4: 2365 – use for print/catering only. Note swiped amounts in expense memo.
- Company P-Card (ops) last4: 9041 — RESERVED: AV rental only.
- Personal cover: avoid if possible; if you must, mark reimb and attach receipts + short justification.

QUICK SWIPE LOG TEMPLATE (paste into expense comments):
- Date | Card(last4) | Vendor | Amount | Category | Notes + attendee initials
- Example: 2025-11-05 | 2365 | LocalPrintCo | $680.00 | Booth-printing | 1x backwall + same-day turnaround | LM

RECEIPT CAPTURE PROCESS (must follow before reimbursement):
- Photo receipt immediately (phone). Save in folder: Drive -> Events/DevWeek/Receipts (I will move later).
- Run OCR quick-check (phone gallery -> text) to confirm vendor name & amount.
- If card declined or partial, take cashier name and till tape photo.
- For cash tips > $10, add note: "tip" and who received it.

VENDORS & HANDOFFS (priority contacts)
- LocalPrintCo — Vanessa Rios — vanessa@localprintco.io — +1 415-555-0122
  - Notes: overnight banner + install. Ask for proof of install (photo).
- BayCatering — Marcus Lee — marcus@baycater.com — +1 415-555-0441
  - Notes: boxed lunches for crew. Use virtual card 2365; specify allergy flags in order notes.
- RapidAV — Ops Desk — ops@rapidav.io — +1 415-555-0789 (on-site: Jake)
  - Notes: AV rental charged to P-Card 9041. Confirm rack-space and ethernet run on Wed AM.
- LocalTaxi / Ride-app — use "Lyft Line" promo code: RWDEV25 (expires 2025-11-15)
  - When reimbursing rides > $60, get driver name and partial screenshot of route.

WHO TO CALL IF CARD ISSUES:
- Finance ops (payments): Sana Iqbal — sana@redwood.com — +1 650-555-1010
- EventsOps finance backup: Evan Brooks — evan@redwood.com — +1 650-555-0922
- If virtual card blocked mid-day: Slack @payments -> tag "urgent-card" and call Sana.

EXPENSE CATEGORIES (for quick coding)
- Booth – printing, furniture, shipping = code: 600-B (use for vendor invoices)
- Catering / Crew food = 610-F
- AV / Rentals = 620-A
- Travel (rides, parking) = 700-T
- Misc (tips, supplies < $50) = 800-M

COMMON EDGE CASES / NOTES TO SELF:
- If vendor wants tax exemption paperwork, use PO# RW-DEVWEEK-PO1 and CC procurement@redwood.com
- For split payments: capture two receipts and mark each with partial amounts + card last4
- If refund expected (over-ordering), ask vendor to issue credit memo referencing invoice number and copy finance.

DAY-OF CHECKLIST (short):
- 06:00 — confirm pickup with LocalPrintCo (Vanessa) for banner
- 07:00 — load-in crew check (crew list pinned to booth binder)
- 07:15 — AV tech (Jake) connect and test mic
- 11:30 — boxed lunches delivered to staff corner (verify by count)
- EOD — collect all receipts, snap photos of cash tips, and drop in Drive folder

POST-EVENT RECONCILIATION (48–72h):
- Consolidate receipts into one sheet (simple cols: date, last4, vendor, amount, code, note)
- Upload scanned receipts (PDFs) and attach to expense claim in Concur (or finance ticket).
- Flag any vendor invoices older than 10 days for AP follow-up.

OPEN QUESTIONS / TODOS (unresolved):
- Confirm whether Amex virtual card has single-use merchant lock — if yes, request extra card for same-day multiple purchases. (TODO: ask Sana)
- Clarify per-diem policy for international attendees (we have mixed crew). (TODO: contact HR reimburse@redwood.com)
- Confirm whether AV on-site tech labor is billable to event vs. product team. (TODO: Evan + PM lead)

HANDOFF NOTES IF I AM OUT:
- If Leah unavailable, hand receipts + phone to Evan. Include quick index (sheet) with totals and card last4.
- Urgent vendor disputes: start a JIRA ticket RW-AP-ATTN and tag finance-team.

SNIPPET: expense text to paste into ticket (one-liner):
"Booth printing (LocalPrintCo) — 2025-11-05 — $680.00 charged to virtual card 2365. Attached receipt and photo of install. Code: 600-B. Leah M. (on-site)"

END NOTES: Keep this doc lean — copy into shared drive events doc after show. Will convert to final vendor handoff checklist after reconciliation.

-- Leah M.
